firestoreSerializedSamples.implication: capacity cannot be safely expressed as a fixed path count; provenance-rich Hint size varies by orders of magnitude. Measure encoded Firestore document bytes and enforce a byte-aware surfaced failure policy.

historicalMissingnessComparison.finding: Historical unknown capability context has not merely remained ambiguous: read-normalize-write cycles can persist upgradeProvenanceEntry()'s synthesized false values. Current raw storage therefore cannot use explicit false as proof that old observations recorded false unless source generation/ingress proves it.
historicalMissingnessComparison.mechanism: level-data-io reads provenance through upgradeProvenanceEntry(); that adapter fills absent usedExistingHints/hintGuided/isolatedTechnique with false; a later canonical hint-file write serializes the expanded hintRecords and can materialize those synthesized values.
historicalMissingnessComparison.correctionRule: Treat historical source-generation absence as unknown at semantic ingress even if a later storage rewrite materialized false. Do not infer original false from current physical presence alone. Future write paths must preserve an explicit semantic unknown state rather than laundering it into a default.
historicalMissingnessComparison.scopeNote: usedExistingHints/hintGuided were already physically expanded by the September 11 snapshot; isolatedTechnique supplies the clean before/after proof that later storage rewrites can collapse legacy absence into explicit modern booleans.

migrationSyntheticFoundAt.interpretation: The cohort is stable back to the September 11 raw store and confined to the legacy stress-1 migration population. Use migration/source-shape membership plus the timestamp cluster as the compatibility predicate; timestamp alone is not a universal rule.
migrationSyntheticFoundAt.correctionTarget: semantic compatibility adapter exposes foundAt as historically unknown for the proven migration-synthetic cohort; do not invent discovery times. A later reversible physical migration may encode that unknown explicitly.

firestoreSizing.measurementKind: UTF-8 JSON payload proxy/lower bound, before Firestore field/index overhead and other levelData fields
firestoreSizing.finding: Path-count caps are not a capacity contract. At current provenance density the median published corpus hint array proxy already exceeds 1 MiB before level metadata/Firestore overhead, while one-event supplemental documents remain small. A full-Hint-per-path Firestore document can also grow dangerously large as provenance accumulates.
firestoreSizing.capacityTarget: preflight actual encoded document size and surface overflow explicitly. Prefer a layout whose growth unit is bounded (semantic-event/occurrence child documents or another sharded representation) over silently truncating paths/events. Exact Firestore SDK/emulator wire-size validation should accompany implementation, but the current five/1000/5000 count policies are already disproven as semantically principled limits.

findings.finding: The empirical consolidation census parsed physical artifact rows directly, so interned v4 provenance appeared absent. Fixed to decode through the shared semantic codec.

Three maintained solver-discovery workflows still had direct canonical Hint persistence after Phase 6 was reported closed. Their source workflows are now report-only and harvest-solver-evidence.yml is the sole canonical persistence authority.
Batch family-parent replay parsed physical hint artifacts and iterated artifact.hints directly. Fixed to decode through decodeHintArtifact before semantic replay.
Already-migrated workflows retained empty Hint-directory staging/git-status plumbing. Removed so source workflows no longer understand canonical Hint-store paths as transport.

Local-corpus hint approval persisted only the last provenance event for each submitted Hint even though the local store supports one document per (path,event), and capacity-refused submissions were still deleted. Fixed to persist every event, dedupe idempotently, and retain the submission whenever any event hits capacity.

Batch replay merged provenance with levelRevision:null and filled levelRevision afterward. Because levelRevision participates in semantic event identity, reruns could create duplicates before mutating them into the same identity. Fixed by computing the hint-excluding level fingerprint once per parent before merge.

Published-level import deduped incoming hints by path and skipped an already-known path entirely, discarding new provenance/occurrence evidence and failing to mark provenance-only changes for persistence. Fixed to use mergeHints(), persist semantic-only changes, and regression-test idempotent same-path enrichment.

Guidance-divergence analysis parsed stress hint artifacts and iterated physical document.hints directly. Interned v4 rows are not semantic Hint provenance. Fixed to decode with decodeHintArtifact before filtering witnesses.

Cost-drift analysis parsed physical Hint rows directly. Under interned v4 this could silently miss/garble provenance, including on the newly-centralized diagnostics path. Fixed to decode every artifact through the shared semantic codec.

Browser variety-search provenance projected only newlySaved paths, dropped documented independent rediscoveries, and omitted VarietySavedMeta.scoringProfileId. Submission mode also derived usedExistingHints after adding new paths, which could label a cold successful search as history-aware. Fixed the canonical projection to preserve new + rediscovered events, scoring profile, seed/anchor identity, and pre-search hint context.

The permanent physical-reader guard only recognized inline JSON.parse(readFile...) shapes and a narrow variable-name set, so staged read/parse refactors could evade raw v4-reader detection. Hardened to combine independent read/parse/Hint-source/.hints signals and added a permanent detector self-test.

The plan required fail-closed ownership for direct canonical Hint file writers, but existing guards covered obsolete facades and GHA persistence rather than arbitrary maintained filesystem writers. Added direct-writer detection plus an explicit reviewed-owner ledger.

The Hint physical-surface and central-persistence guards did not declare the filesystem authorities they dynamically inspect, so scoped CI could omit them on relevant changes. Added repo-input dependency surfaces for source/workflow/ledger and lifecycle changes.

Editor coordinate transforms cleared level.hints directly but left canonical level.hintRecords intact, allowing stale transformed Hint evidence to survive. Fixed to clear via setLevelHintRecords(level, []) and made maintained direct .hints/.hintRecords assignments fail closed through an explicit review ledger.

The consolidation plan promised a lightweight freshness-bound Hint index, but no such derived artifact/index generator existed. Added a deterministic per-artifact index using canonical decode/query/reconstructability semantics plus source content/semantic hashes and stale-index verification.

PSC-015 remained in-progress even though its provenance-generation/missingness retirement gate had been satisfied by shared historical ingress semantics and the lossless v4 migration; PSC-001 also described the now-fixed editor bare-hints transform as an acceptable residual. Reconciled both rows to current implementation truth.

decodeHintArtifact explicitly handled v4 but then accepted any object with a hints array as legacy, so an unsupported future declared schema could be silently misread. Added authoritative v2/v3/v4 dispatch, fail-closed unsupported versions, regression tests, and closed PSC-024.

The original Phase-8 migration and whole-store tooling assumed three Hint stores. A mechanical tree census found six: envelope (124 files) plus two canonical family stores (788 + 477) were omitted, leaving 1,389 tracked schema-v3 artifacts after a purported full-corpus migration. Whole-store tooling now discovers Hint directories mechanically; a full six-store repair migrated exactly those 1,389 files with semantic/join equivalence and immediate idempotency.

The Phase-8 migration manifest proved semantic and join-identity equivalence but contained no referee-validation disposition despite the plan requiring one; existing validators did not cover the omitted family stores. Added a mechanically discovered all-store owner/path referee validator. The repair workflow's piped invocation is explicitly rejected as evidence because it could mask failure; final hostile/closeout runs execute the validator directly.

The diagnostics harvester real-row canary rewrote tracked data/hints/P00001.json while the Node suite runs concurrently, creating a race where another reader could observe truncated JSON. CI reproduced the failure. Added an explicit harvester --root fixture seam and moved the canary to an isolated temporary corpus.

Physical Hint reader/writer detection still encoded the old published/stress path topology after six canonical stores were established. Bound detection to CANONICAL_TRACKED_HINT_STORE_DIRS, added family/helper-derived adversarial fixtures, and made review ledgers fail on stale as well as missing classifications.

Whole-store PLAY referee validation discovered stores but did not require the complete canonical population, so disappearance of a store could shrink the proof silently. Default validation now asserts the full store authority; fixture-only partial mode is explicit.
Closeout printed same-input/different-path counts but never failed. Canonical solverRequestIdentity collisions are now separated from legacy recorded-input reconciliation and hard-fail closeout.

Occurrence acceptance and reconstructability still omitted both family stores after the six-store repair. Both now derive and assert the complete canonical store population and decode every artifact through the shared boundary.

Workflow-ingestion completeness checked only rows already present in its hand-maintained inventory. It now derives candidates from maintained evidence-producing lifecycle rows plus standard solver-sweep publishers and requires exactly one reviewed Hint-ingestion disposition per candidate.

A maintained GHA family workflow directly persists canonical family Hints and can stage data/families/ as an ancestor scope. The old guard missed both family stores and ancestor staging. The family research transaction is now an explicit, scope-limited reviewed exception; all other maintained workflows remain fail-closed.

Diagnostics already uploads full/partial artifacts under if: always(), but inventory/test retained a false partialFailureUpload exemption. Reconciled current truth, removed the exception, and bound the mechanical workflow guards to all dynamically scanned scoped-CI inputs.
